messages:
Elena (CEO): thanks for coming to the sec/privacy segment — quick live q&a for anything we didn't cover in slides. feel free to drop short questions and we'll triage. :raised_hands:
sam (PM): first q — timeline: when are we targeting SOC 2 Type II and ISO readiness for hosted customers?
Arman (CISO): SOC 2 Type II — we plan to finish the audit window by Q3 and have report available in early Q4. ISO 27001 assessment kickoff is scheduled for late Q3, with certification expected by end of year if no major gaps. both timelines assume current remediation plan stays on track.
Jo (Eng Infra): to add, for Dedicated customers some controls are already in place so onboarding is faster.
Priya (Head of Product): follow-up — will those certifications affect feature rollout cadence?
Arman (CISO): short answer: minimal impact. We'll gate only security-sensitive features behind the compliance baseline. Most improvements are ops/controls and won't block product launches.
Kofi (Legal): reminder — customers under enterprise contracts can request evidence earlier via our legal team (NDA + DPA).
sam (PM): question about VPC/private deploy: any change to the roadmap or delivery ETA?
Jo (Eng Infra): VPC private deploys: GA for a limited pilot in Q3, broader availability by Q4. pilot customers will help validate audit logging + SaaS control plane separation.
Elena (CEO): we heard feedback about audit log retention and accessibility — quick summary?
Arman (CISO): default hosted retention is 90 days for detailed request logs, 1 year for aggregated usage. For Dedicated/Private we offer customizable retention policies; enterprise add-on for long-term archival (S3/HSM-backed).
sam (PM): can customers pull raw audit logs or do we provide a UI/export?
Jo (Eng Infra): both. there's an API and an S3 export option for Dedicated/Private. Hosted customers will have UI-driven exports and APIs in next release.
A user (question via thread): what about KMS/BYOK — can customers bring keys?
Arman (CISO): yes — BYOK (bring your own key) is supported for Private and Dedicated. For hosted we plan a KMS multi-tenant option with customer-managed keys (wrapped) later this year. HSM integrations for the highest tier are on the roadmap.
Kofi (Legal): note re: BYOK — contractual obligations differ (key custody, access, key rotation policies). legal will need to sign off on BYOK addenda for enterprise deals.
Priya (Head of Product): question — will BYOK change backup/restore flows or disaster recovery?
Jo (Eng Infra): design note: when BYOK is used, backups are encrypted with customer keys. recovery workflows will require key access from the customer side unless escrow is agreed. we'll document recovery SLAs clearly in the enterprise package.
sam (PM): performance question — does KMS/BYOK add latency to inference?
Arman (CISO): negligible for most ops; key ops are infrequent (encryption/decryption of model blobs or tokens at rest). For per-request crypto paths we avoid customer key ops on the hot path; we use envelope encryption and cached DEKs.
Elena (CEO): ops question — how do we handle incident reporting for privacy/security events?
Arman (CISO): we have an incident playbook: triage, customer notification in accordance with contract timelines, and postmortem. For severe incidents we provide a dedicated incident bridge and an executive summary within 72 hours.
Priya (Head of Product): is there a plan for customer-facing compliance dashboard?
Jo (Eng Infra): yes — console will show certs, audit log export, and a compliance checklist for onboarding. initial version by Q4.
A user: will the console include per-route token-level billing + PII redaction controls?
sam (PM): token billing already per-route in beta. PII redaction is part of Optimize and Privacy Controls roadmap — we'll pilot with a few customers first.
Kofi (Legal): quick legal flag — retention policies and redaction affect data subject requests. please coordinate with legal on DSR workflows.
Elena (CEO): thanks, all. if you have specific enterprise needs (audit artifacts, KMS configs), please DM Arman + Kofi and we'll prioritize in the roadmap. closing the thread in ~24h and we'll surface follow-ups in the product/infra channels. :rocket: 
deploy-bot: Reminder: "security-compliance-package-v2" docs updated at https://internal.redwood/docs/sec-compliance-v2
Arman (CISO): linking our tracker for follow-ups: PRD updates for BYOK, audit log exports, compliance dashboard. will post milestones in #eng-security.
Priya (Head of Product): i'll send a short summary email with timelines and who to contact for pilot requests.
Elena (CEO): appreciate the questions — really helpful signal. we'll keep the momentum.
